v1_9_0.title: Nexus Mods Downloader & In-Library Preset Management
highlights: Integrated high-speed Nexus Mods downloader with download manager and automatic post-download installation
Streamlined preset workflow: removed dedicated preset page; manage, save, import and export presets directly inside Library
changes: Added Nexus Mods download and download manager with progress tracking, speed calculation, pause/resume, and auto-installation
Added Nexus account and Premium status verification in Settings to unlock direct high-speed downloads
Refactored presets: streamlined side navigation and added "Save as Preset" in Library to snapshot enabled mods
Added "Preset Management" modal in Library for switching, editing, deleting, and importing/exporting preset bundles

v1_8_7.title: Installer Experience Upgrade & Performance Improvements
highlights: Upgraded installer experience: defaults to direct in-place update when an older version is detected, preserving all personal configurations and mods
Greatly reduced memory consumption during mod processing and verification for smoother management of large mods
changes: Optimized Windows installer logic to default to direct overwrite update without uninstalling existing user data
Optimized mod file verification pipeline, significantly cutting memory usage and boosting performance
Improved asset bundling and code splitting for faster startup and smoother page navigation
Updated core runtime libraries to enhance overall app stability and performance

v1_8_6.title: Multi-Version Mod Conflict Management & Precise Instance Targeting
highlights: Added automatic multi-version mod conflict detection and a dedicated Version Retention Panel with one-click cleanup
Refactored mod uninstall and folder location to use precise physical file paths, completely resolving accidental deletion across versions
changes: Added Version Retention Panel: visual version comparison, switch active version, keep & clean old versions, delete specific instance
Fixed critical bug where deleting a disabled mod with duplicate ID mistakenly uninstalled the enabled version
Added multi-version conflict badge (⚠️), conflict quick filter, and mutual exclusion guard preventing duplicate active versions
Optimized mod operations and fixed duplicate DOM key collisions for multi-instance mods

v1_8_5.title: Discover Page Translation & Quality of Life Improvements
highlights: Improved translation text formatting with line limits and hover popover
Optimized code and improved overall performance
changes: Added line clamping and hover popover to translated mod descriptions in Discover
Added Release Notes modal, accessible anytime in Settings -> About
Optimized code and improved overall performance
Fixed minor stability issues

v1_8_4.title: Custom Background & Tooltip Improvements
changes: Added custom background wallpaper and blur slider
Improved tooltip display rendering
Optimized code and improved overall performance
